title: LOOK: Xi welcomes Trump, Putin before trilateral summit in China

blocks.text: SHENZEN, China — Chinese President Xi Jinping will host US leader Donald Trump and Russia’s Vladimir Putin on Thursday for a keenly anticipated first trilateral summit likely to center around major international conflicts. The three-way meeting comes with Russia’s years-long offensive in Ukraine grinding on, Trump bogged down in his war with Iran, and an ascendant China looking to strengthen its hand in East Asia.
